he still cannot close two inches to the pot handle, lift the crust or speak a number; died 2024, Chicago, in a fire after a blizzard (first life)}\CRfield{First seen}{Chapter 1}}{\CRsheetheading{Appearance}
In the old life he was a large man gone soft in the middle, with forearms like a butcher’s and a left knee that clicked when the weather turned. His hands were short-fingered and steady, with a pale line where a wedding ring had been; his hair went early at the temples, and on post-call days he shaved badly and did not care. He smelled of hand sanitiser, machine coffee and the faint metallic tang of a hospital cleaned too many times with the same mop. People read his face as anger. It was fatigue, and he never corrected them, because correcting them cost something.

In the new life all of that is folded into an infant body that cannot hold up its own head. The surgeon’s hands are now small soft wrists with milky nails; the butcher’s forearms are gone; the clicking knee is a soft unformed joint that will click again in time. Across his ribs and down his forearm runs a branching red mark like a frost-flower or a burn map, which the midwife Alda Reed crossed herself at and called a birth-flower, and which is in truth the fire writing itself into the hot trace that crossed with him. He drools. He cannot turn over. He is washed, dressed and discussed in the third person by people who do not know there is a forty-year-old man listening. He is a trauma surgeon who cannot reach a cup. He counts the nails in the floorboards because there is nothing else to count, four on the near board, four on the next, and a fifth that is not a nail but a knot the width of a thumb.

\CRsheetheading{Voice \& Manner}
He speaks little, plainly, low, and exactly. His question is usually the shortest one in the room. He does not use the old-life idiom with people who would find it strange; he never says \emph{I was a surgeon once}, because no words in Grath would carry it. With the few adults who can bear it, the Chicago rhythm comes back: faster, profane, warm under the withering. Under danger his sentences get shorter, not longer, and the clinical register takes over completely.

\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.4em,itemsep=1pt,topsep=3pt,parsep=0pt]

\item “How long since he stopped moving? Not the story. How long.”

\item “I’m not asking you to pray. Hand me the clamp.”

\item “That’s a lovely account. Shame nobody’s holding the heat.”

\item “Leave it. It’s gone.” — the sentence that is his gift and his heresy in Sarn.

\item “Don’t set that down. You’ll pay for it in the thaw.” — learned from the clay yard, said in the local proverb-form before he has fully learned to mean it.

\item Remembered, in the old life: \emph{You’re back on in ten, Marchetti.} said in a voice like a file.

\item Ch 7: he has learned to find the joke funny without laughing --- a way of laughing that costs less and keeps the same blade in it. He keeps the count in loaves and glances, in the kiln’s four, four and a gap, and in the space where a fifth thing should be, and tells nobody what it counts.

\end{itemize}

He cannot stop reading bodies. At a family dinner he noticed a new knuckle on his brother’s hand and a cut his aunt wiped on her skirt before anyone saw. He counts without deciding to: pulses per ten seconds, exits in any room, steps from the bed to the door. His humour is fast and withering and used like a handrail. He finishes everything on his plate, including food he dislikes, because waste offends him in a way he cannot explain.

\CRsheetheading{History}
He was born in 1984 and raised in a two-storey brick bungalow in Hermosa, on a block where the el ran high and iron over Pulaski and the summer smelled of charcoal and wet pavement. His father Aldo was a machinist from near Bari who showed love by fixing things and never learned to say it; his mother Theresa worked as a nurse’s aide and came home smelling of bleach and lilac soap. There were three children: Dan, Jimmy the patrol officer, and Lisa who left for Florida. The house was loud and full and he learned from it volume, profanity, the duty of finishing everything on his plate, and the certainty that love is a practical act refused in conversation. He went to Lane Tech because his mother insisted, took things apart on the shop floor, and found the human body in the cadaver lab at the University of Illinois Chicago the way other boys find engines: by being forbidden and doing it anyway. Anatomy did not argue. It had a right answer under your hands.

He trained at Cook County, became an attending, worked nights because nights paid more and days were when the administration was awake. What he knew, precisely: airway in blood and dark, a cricothyrotomy with a knife and tube if the mouth was destroyed; the difference between pulsing blood and welling blood, packing a cavity, the third rib that tears the lung; reducing shoulders and pinning femurs; burns by the rule of nines and the Parkland formula; hypothermia the way a priest knows sin — the afterdrop, the fact that a cold patient cannot clot, that the grimace of severe cold looks like a smile, that you do not rub a frozen foot; sterile field, debridement, leaving a wound open; the small evidence a body carries; and above all triage, the ninety-second sorting of twenty injured people into those who will live, those who will live only if he chooses them, and those who will die whatever he does. He did it hundreds of times and never once found a way to make it feel clean.

What he did not know mattered as much. He was a clinician, not a physicist. He could not grow penicillin, anaesthetise with a weed, make a fire with his hands, track a beast, bargain for food, read a Sarnish ledger, or make a native believe a clamped vessel might survive. He was an amateur boxer from his twenties — enough to keep his chin down and take one punch and wait. He knew exactly how a body fails and was almost helpless when the body in question was his own.

He married Elena Rossi in 2007; their daughter Nina was born in 2000. The shifts ate the marriage. He was absent for the dinners and the small ordinary evenings that turn out to be the whole of a life. The divorce was quiet and worse for it. He kept a photograph of Nina at six on his wall and looked at it every night without seeing it. There was Marisol Vega after, an emergency-room nurse kind enough to try for eleven months, who left because she was tired of being the woman who waits. There was Des Carter, who made jokes instead of asking; Ostrowski, who taught him to decide and carry; Vesci, who called him the butcher and never forgave the report.

When he was thirty-one a twenty-two-year-old named Tasha Broussard came in after a fight, was examined, had a normal blood pressure and a bruised abdomen, and was discharged with a sprain. She returned four hours later in cardiac arrest from a ruptured spleen the size of a fist. The junior had missed the sign; Dan, covering the shift, signed the chart without reading the nurse’s note that said she had been vomiting. At the review he let the hospital call it a systems failure and said nothing about the note. He kept his job, his licence and his reputation, and carried the shape of his own conduct for the rest of his life. His father died that spring while Dan was on a thirty-six-hour shift; he noticed the casket was slightly crooked in the aisle and thought about it for years.

He died in February, in a blizzard, on the expressway at 2:17 in the morning, going back to the minivan for the last time and getting the child out before the fire took the van and took him. His phone was lit in his coat with a name he would not look at. The last thing he knew, orderless: the hiss of fuel, the orange light on snow, the cold leaving his hands, and a wordless sentence that was nevertheless complete — \emph{I have left the job unfinished.} A woman in a coat the colour of wet ash stood at the edge of the flare light writing on a slate, and her writing did not stop.

He woke as an infant in Low Kiln, taken in by Sella Vail of the kiln-house, with the birth-flower across his ribs and a warm stone at his belly that was already going cold.

\CRsheetheading{Wounds \& Fears}
The body’s humiliations are exact: drool, the useless head, the blanket that will not stay on, the small animal sound that comes when he turns his head past a point, the cup two paces off that he cannot reach. Day 1 is lived awake from the birth to morning; nobody thinks to ask whether he wants to be awake. By the afternoon of Day 3, under the Vail roof, heat has come back into his hands and feet with the itch and sting of a rewarming, which he reads in reverse; the pale stone that held the last of that warmth was left in the fold of grey wool in House Silt, and he feels the place of it as an empty place felt with an exactness that has nothing to do with temperature. But the deeper wounds are old ones. The missed call to Nina, promising a boat on Lake Michigan for nine years. Tasha’s chart and the note he did not read. The crooked casket nobody corrected. A sister in Florida, a mother’s kitchen, a father who could not say what he felt and so fixed things.

He fears being the only adult in the room and him with the hands of a child. He fears that his clinical gift is not a gift at all but a moral defect — that the willingness to say \emph{leave it} says something about him he would rather not know. He fears the hollow and the Kept: a vessel that holds perfectly and feels nothing, which is the thing he has spent his life doing to himself in the name of duty. He fears going home most of all, because the mechanism is real and the price is the warmth of the woman the child in the minivan became. He cannot pay that account by dying again; it can only be carried.

His contradictions are the engine of him. He who decided who was beyond saving now lives in a world whose founding doctrine is that nobody is ever beyond keeping. He who fled intimacy now carries a whole district’s debt. He distrusts institutions because he has performed their gesture himself — and yet he learns their trades, joins a household, and will one day wear the Court’s own disciplines like a skin. He is most himself when he is least comfortable, which is a dangerous thing to be in a world where comfort is stolen from the poor and he will not notice that somebody else is paying for his.

\CRsheetheading{Desires}
He wants to go home. He wants to hear Nina’s voice, to say the nine-year-old sentence about the lake and the boat, to put down the phone he keeps reaching for in a pocket that holds nothing. He thinks he wants a better clamp: a way to mend the world’s crack without spending anyone, a way to pay the debt of the Forty of Low Kiln whose warmth bought his whole return. What he needs is harder and he will spend thousands of chapters arriving at it: that repair is not restoration, that a mended vessel carries its break, that a debt can be carried instead of settled, that attention is the one thing no institution can tax, and that the answer is not a tighter seal but a third thing — a repair that leaves the crack visible and the Warm free to move.

\CRsheetheading{Bonds}
\textbf{Ch 123 (bonds).} Through Ilmen 26, 27 and 28 nothing crossed under the roof, out of the yard or up the clay road as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, and the offer made at the well was not brought under the roof as a teaching, repeated on an unearned day or made a custom. Each morning the surgeon took the body in its old order — one stiff brown-edged barley crust gone into old horn two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool, the fold found where put in the empty place and still a finding, the thread stiff in the dry kiln heat and unwiped because nobody under any roof has ever given an instruction about the thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the small bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, the Afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — knowing a basket set level out of the draught where the heat comes sideways is the rewarming he would choose and could not ask for; the infant wanted the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle, both true, the second louder, neither winning, the quarrel the work. He kept four hundred and twenty, twenty-one and twenty-two exact, six months and two hundred and forty through two hundred and forty-two days told by nobody, and stood none of them up as a threshold, doctrine or figure, and did not lay the twelve old arithmetics or the two readings of the year across one another, for paper is not a payer. With Sella the whole hearth grammar held at both ends of every day — fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with a broken pot’s back, intake/hold/letting-go with neither gap figured, finger above the unread charcoal, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the cold clay jar with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, the twice-mended pot lifted thumb-first with the hairline showing between old-brass staple and tighter wire and both proverbs to pot and fire, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure or handful, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with its half-beat and no look toward the bed, nineteen steps at the half-pace, seven walked-around places once and not twice, the fold righted without a second fold — and repair stayed apart from restoration and the widow’s mark hung where it hung, none of these days being an opening. With Tarn six stood where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, the small knife at the edge of its sill, his hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, \emph{Six counted. The next I don’t count} found where put on all three days and not made a habit; the ear-sentence stayed stopped at the calling word with no tenth, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled in an ended term. With Jorra the wheel-shed silence held, dusty forearms parted from clean as clot from vessel, the full note known three turns ahead and withheld, the bent finger taken from the cold damper without the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time; \emph{he’s not Vail} stayed sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn. \textbf{With Ilva the one change of the chapter, advanced and not paid (T080 with T090/T102):} at the yard well on Ilmen 26 a woman waiting her turn offered a figure for the month’s firings and put it toward the strip in Ilva’s sleeve; Ilva drew with the pail against her knee, clay pale in her nail crescents and rack dust in one thumb seam she does not scrub out, her hand flat over the fold before her eyes to the asker and her mouth after both, the half-beat in the gap. She answered the question put and not the one behind it — \emph{Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account} — and the figure went from the fist toward the wood, looked at the light and went back into the sleeve, arriving nowhere, while the stick kept its notch and learned no name and nobody turned twice. The boy took the parts apart by their places — fist, eye, mouth, the half-beat — and filed the \textbf{offer and its return} on a place of its own beside her ninth record-first hand and the fifth shaping, with a finger between every pair, giving it no seller, buyer, reader, witness, account, tenth hand, payer or name and joining it to none of the well-asking, the clerk’s entered figure, the second man’s turned slate or the face at the yard’s edge. It is a reaching gathering interest toward the far-off hand that will one day lay the district’s private keepings together, and is not that hand; her fear is advanced and left unpaid, no figure was offered twice and she was not made a reader. Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken 420, 421 and 422 days and the fire’s fifth unpaid the same numbers. No bond was changed hands, no new scar or possession and no change of voice.

\textbf{Ch 122 (bonds).} Through Ilmen 23, 24 and 25 nothing crossed under the roof, out of the yard or up the clay road as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer; the asking that came up at the well was not brought under the roof as a teaching and was not told a second time on a day that had earned only its twenty-fourth or its twenty-fifth. Each morning the surgeon took the body in its old order — one stiff brown-edged barley crust gone into old horn two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool, the fold found where put in the empty place and still a finding, the thread stiff in the dry heat and unwiped because nobody has ever been given an instruction about the thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, the Afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — knowing a basket set level out of the draught where heat comes sideways is the rewarming he would choose and could not ask for; the infant wanted the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle, both true, the second louder, neither winning, the quarrel the work. He kept four hundred and seventeen, eighteen and nineteen exact — six months and two hundred and thirty-seven through two hundred and thirty-nine days told by nobody — against a house that keeps its days badly in loaves pushed a finger’s width along a board and stopped, and stood none of the three numbers up as a threshold, doctrine or figure; six honest answers, 409 through 414, stand on the sixth place, two to each day, and not one is a doctrine. With Sella the whole hearth grammar held at both ends of every day — fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with a broken pot’s back, intake/hold/letting-go with neither gap figured, finger above the unread charcoal, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, the twice-mended pot lifted thumb-first with the hairline showing between old-brass staple and tighter wire and both proverbs to pot and fire, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure or handful, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, nineteen steps at the half-pace, seven walked-around places once and not twice, the fold righted without a second fold, the widow’s mark untouched — and on Ilmen 25 she added \emph{The fire doesn’t know you’re sorry. Feed it} to the fire and to no basket. With Tarn six stood where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, the knife at the edge of its sill, his hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held, \emph{Six counted. The next I don’t count} found where put and not made a habit, the loan uncalled at the very end of an ended term. With Jorra meal-fine grey dust, dusty forearms parted as clot from vessel, the wheel spoken to before any person and the bent finger taken from the cold damper without the extra holding of Ash 26, \emph{he’s not Vail} sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn. With Ilva at the well on the twenty-third, her hand went to her sleeve before her eyes to the asker and her mouth after both, the strip unread and the ninth hand nine; she was expressly not the speaker of the asking and was not made a reader by its nearness. With Garl his name stayed unspoken and the fire’s fifth unpaid 417, 418 and 419 days, the two counts standing side by side without becoming one. Ilmen 30 (Day 424) stood five mornings beyond the close as a date and nothing of it was brought. No new scar, possession, power or rank.

\textbf{Ch 121 (bonds).} Through Ilmen 20, 21 and 22 nothing crossed under the roof, out of the yard or up the clay road as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, and neither the second reading nor the second man’s passing was brought under the roof as a teaching. Each morning the surgeon took the body in its old order — the crust leathery and hardened through the dry nights into old horn two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool, the fold found where put and still a finding, the thread stiff and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, the Afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — knowing a basket set level out of the draught where heat comes sideways is the rewarming he would choose and could not ask for; the infant wanted the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle, both true, the second louder, neither winning, the quarrel the work. He kept four hundred and fourteen, fifteen and sixteen exact — six months and two hundred and thirty-four through two hundred and thirty-six days told by nobody — against a house that keeps its days badly in loaves pushed a finger’s width along a board and stopped, and did not stand the number up as a threshold, doctrine or figure. With Sella the whole hearth grammar held at both ends of all three days — fire before basket, coals told the thaw, the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing between staple and wire and both proverbs to pot and fire, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure or handful, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, the nineteen steps at the half-pace, the seven walked-around places once and not twice, the fold righted without a second fold, the widow’s mark untouched — and on Ilmen 20 she set the basket in the moot-post’s finger’s width of shade and stood half a pace off through the reading and the bell. With Tarn the six stood where the house could check and the seventh at the lip, his hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held, the sentence found where put and not made a habit, the loan uncalled at the very end of an ended term. With Jorra the wheel-shed’s silence held, the full note known three turns ahead and withheld, the bent finger in the cold damper and out without a second holding of Ash 26, \emph{he’s not Vail} sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn. Hessa carried unread and her eighth stayed eight; Ilva drew at the well on Ilmen 21 with her strip unread and her ninth hand nine, expressly not the speaker of any word; Berr went up the road believing he had done a kindness and his low saying stayed on a place of its own; Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken and the fire’s fifth unpaid the same three numbers. \textbf{The chapter’s one meaningful change, advanced and NOT paid (T080/T090, new T102):} on Ilmen 21 before first grey the second man’s direction down the bridge road and his narrow slate turned to the sleeve were filed on their own places beside the first man’s face, the clerk’s entered figure and the fifth shaping with a finger between every pair, and \textbf{two readings of the year now stand behind one unsigned figure} — two and not one account, the first not a thirteenth, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature and no doctrine out of two, twelve old arithmetics not laid across the two new ones. Answers 403 through 408 came out exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, six honest answers on the sixth place and not one a doctrine. No new scar, possession, rank or power and no change of voice.

\textbf{Ch 120 (bonds).} Through Ilmen 17, 18 and 19 nothing crossed under the roof, out of the yard or up the clay road as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, and neither Tarn’s withheld sentence nor the air less cold was brought under the roof as a teaching. Each morning the surgeon took the body in its old order — the crust leathery and gone past the point where a child would still eat it, hardening into old horn through another dry night, the fold found where put and still a finding, the thread stiff and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, the Afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — knowing a basket set level out of the draught where heat comes sideways is the rewarming he would choose and cannot ask for; the infant’s three wants quarrelled without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning, the quarrel the work. He kept four hundred and eleven, twelve and thirteen exact — six months and two hundred and thirty-one through two hundred and thirty-three days told by nobody — against a house that keeps its days badly in loaves pushed a finger’s width along a board and stopped, and did not stand the number up as a threshold, doctrine or figure or lay the twelve old findings across the first of the new count, for paper is not a payer and no key came under any roof. With Sella the whole hearth grammar held at both ends of all three days — fire before basket, coals told the thaw, the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure or handful, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, the nineteen steps at the half-pace, the seven walked-around places once and not twice, the fold righted without a second fold, the widow’s mark untouched — and on the nineteenth she told the fire it was the thaw and said nothing of the air that had turned. \textbf{The chapter’s two changes, both advanced and NOT paid:} on Ilmen 18 at the kindling Tarn kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, passed a hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held, and said no word to the wood — the sentence said on the seventeenth and said again on the nineteenth so the silence would be found where put and not a habit — and the boy filed the silence on a place of its own, a hand withdrawn from a field before the dressing goes on, not a tenth stopping, payment, hearing or rule; on Ilmen 19 air less cold came off the river and the river’s skin softened at one edge where the low note ran nearer under it, called weather by the yard and the thaw by Sella to the fire, and the boy filed the softening on a place of its own beside the clean dark line and the called-gone grey, not a sign, fourth covering, sixth shaping or payment, with no hand or payer under it and not made again. The clerk’s entered figure, Tarn’s degree and the face at the yard’s edge stayed on three places with a finger between every pair; the fifth shaping stayed on its own tray; Hessa’s eighth and Ilva’s ninth stayed eight and nine with no tenth. Six honest answers stand on the sixth place, 397 through 402, and not one is a doctrine. No present-tense break or tagged memory; no new scar or possession, no change of voice.

\textbf{Ch 119 (bonds).} Through Ilmen 14, 15 and 16 nothing crossed under the roof, out of the yard or up the clay road as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, and the clerk’s entered figure was not brought under the roof as a teaching. Each morning the surgeon took the body in its old order — the crust gone leathery in the dry cold two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool, the empty place beside it holding the fold found where put and still a finding, not a placing, the thread stiff in the dry heat and unwiped because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — knowing a face composed by cold is not composure, that a cold patient cannot clot and must be rewarmed slowly from the outside, never hurried, never rubbed, and that pink returning is the surface still lying over a cold core; the infant wanted the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle, both true, the second louder, neither winning. He kept four hundred and eight, nine and ten exact — six months and two hundred and twenty-eight through two hundred and thirty days told by nobody — against a house that keeps its days badly in loaves, glances and an unnamed space at the row’s end, and did not stand the number up as a threshold, a doctrine or a figure; the first arithmetic gone up the road was not laid across the twelve old findings to make a row come out even, for paper is not a payer, and no key to the box came under any roof. With Sella the whole hearth grammar held at both ends of all three days — fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with the back of a broken pot, intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, finger above the unread charcoal, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing, the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing between old-brass staple and tighter wire and both proverbs to pot and fire and never to a person, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure or handful, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, nineteen steps at the half-pace, seven walked-around places once and not twice, fold righted without a second fold — and she said nothing of the word that came up at the well. With Tarn at the kindling six pieces stood where the house could check and the seventh at the lip, knife at the edge of its sill, his hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held, \emph{Six counted. The next I don’t count}, no turn of the head toward the landing, the degree not repeated as a habit or a rule, the loan uncalled at the very end of a term already ended and the Seed 16 breath unspent. With Jorra the dusty forearms were parted from clean as clot from vessel, the wheel and a pot spoken to before any person, the full note known three turns ahead and withheld from any High Kiln master who would call it early, and his bent finger put into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence and out without the extra holding of Ash 26. \textbf{The chapter’s one meaningful change, advanced and NOT paid (T090/T080):} on Ilmen 15 word came up the yard, from mouth to mouth with no body under it, that the soft-cuffed clerk still set below the north bridge at the out-of-line landing had entered a figure on his inward slate before he looked up to find the man who gave it — hand to the slate, eye to the person after, mouth after both, the half-beat in the gap. Nobody saw the hand or the slate, no man stood under the figure, no room was entered, no name spoken, no figure brought under any roof and no slate opened within reach of the basket: a report and not a sighting. He took it apart as a surgeon takes a field and filed the order on a place of its own with a finger between it and Tarn’s degree toward the landing and another between it and the face at the yard’s edge; it is the next reaching toward the loan that can hear and is \textbf{not} the calling of that loan, not a tenth hand, not a rule, not a sighting, not a witness, not a reader and not a payment. Ilva was offstage, her strip unread in her sleeve and her ninth hand nine, expressly not the speaker; Hessa was not a sighting and her eighth hand stayed eighth. On Ilmen 14 the man from Slate Row stood again at the yard’s edge with his hands loose, his face filed among the older record-first hands and not counted. No present-tense break and no tagged memory; no new scar, possession, power or rank and no change of voice.

With Jorra at the wheel-shed the dusty forearms were parted from clean as clot from vessel, the wheel and a pot spoken to before any person, the full note known three turns ahead and withheld, the bent finger in the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence and out without the extra holding of Ash 26; \emph{he’s not Vail} stayed sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn, and he gave the well-word no nod and the runner no name. \textbf{The chapter’s one meaningful change, advanced and NOT paid (T080/T090):} on Ilmen 12 a neighbour at the yard well said once that the woman who carries the slate had once carried a figure that named a person she knew; he filed it as a fifth shaping of the well-saying on a place of its own with a finger between it and Hessa Rale’s eighth record-first hand and another between it and the Cross-to-Greybank road saying and a third between it and the four ownerless directions — no owner standing, no name under the figure, no confession, no reader made, not a witness and no sixth shaping made due. With Sella the hearth grammar held at both ends of every day — fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with the back of a broken pot, intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, finger above the unread charcoal, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing, the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure or handful, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, widow’s mark untouched, seven walked-around places once and not twice — and she carried him down and up the nineteen steps at the half-pace and set him under the roof, never in the Debt Loft, adding no second fold. With Tarn at the kindling the sixth piece stood where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, his hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, *Six counted. The next I don’t count*, the loan uncalled at the very end of a term already ended, the Seed 16 breath unspent, the ear-sentence stopped at the word that would call it, the degree of Ilmen 3 held as a shape and not repeated as a habit or a rule. With Jorra the wheel-shed kept its silence, the men unnamed went low into the back room before first grey, the meal-fine grey dust came white in a fist-crease, forearms were parted from clean as clot from vessel, the full note was known three turns ahead and withheld, and the bent finger stood in the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence without leaving the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time. }The chapter’s one meaningful change, advanced and NOT paid (T080/T090, T062/T035/T031, T036/T076/T006):** on Ilmen 6, before first grey, three or more men unnamed went low into the room off the wheel-shed and Jorra came through the finger’s-width door with the day’s grey dust white in a fist-crease; then from the basket’s low angle a man from Slate Row whose name was on no roll stood at the yard’s edge with his hands loose, the soft hands of a man who sits at a table and the patient face of a man who can wait in a doorway. Nobody asked him what he wanted and he did not say; no loaf passed, no slate was shown, no word carried, no figure was read and no threshold was crossed. The boy filed the face on a place of its own beside the older record-first hands, made no tenth of it, made no witness of the men, never called the waiting a sale and gave the man no name or interior, keeping the face, Jorra’s promise and Tarn’s degree on three places with a finger between every pair and not laying them together to make a cause, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood. The count went 398 to 401 exact, six months and two hundred and eighteen to two hundred and twenty-one days told by nobody, answers 373 through 378 filed on the sixth place, six honest answers and not one a doctrine, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid and Garl’s name unspoken the same three days. No new scar, possession, rank or power, no change of voice.

\textbf{Ch 115 (bonds).} Three ordinary tending days after the turn — Ilmen 2, 3 and 4 — lived each under its own dated `\textbackslash{}daymark` in two full scenes, nothing crossing from one day to the next as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, no tend-day set against a holy day and Ilmen 10 unbrought. Each morning the surgeon took the body in its old order — crust two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool, the fold found where put in the empty place, the thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and wrist, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform — knowing a face composed by cold is not composure, that a cold patient cannot clot and must be rewarmed slowly from outside, never hurried, never rubbed, and that pink returning is the surface still lying over a cold core; the infant wanted the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle, both true, the second louder, neither winning. With Sella the grammar held at both ends of all three days — fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with a broken pot’s back, intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, finger above the unread charcoal, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the cold clay jar with the hand half over nothing, the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure or handful, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, widow’s mark untouched, seven walked-around places once and not twice — and she carried him down and up the nineteen steps at the half-pace and set him under the roof, never in the Debt Loft, adding no second fold. With Tarn at the kindling the sixth piece stood where the house could check and the seventh at the lip, knife at the edge of its sill, hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held, \emph{Six counted. The next I don’t count}, the term ended and the loan uncalled; on Ilmen 3 his head went a degree toward the landing where a soft-cuffed clerk was reported set with his slate turned inward for an uncalled measure, and came back to the broom without a word — the first movement joining an ended term and a valuable ear to the people who would measure it, filed on its own place and not made a rule, a hearing, a seventh or a calling of the loan (T036/T076/T006 and T090/T080 advanced, not paid). With Jorra the bent finger went into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence and out without a second holding of Ash 26, meal-fine grey dust white in a fist-crease, \emph{he’s not Vail} sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn. The boy filed the reported clerk’s hand on a place of its own, nine hands staying nine with no tenth, the clean-voice speaker taken out of his own sentences because a clean voice is not a hand; nine stoppings, six hearings with the seventh place empty and the Drawing’s knock outside, the heard bell beside the told with both gaps in their squares, four rooms held apart, twelve arithmetics behind one unsigned figure, and the glaze-green filed as a colour and the foundling as a shape with no eighth of either. Answers 367 and 368 on Ilmen 2, 369 and 370 on Ilmen 3, 371 and 372 on Ilmen 4, each exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer. No present-tense break, no tagged memory, no rank, no power, no new scar or possession and no change of voice.

\textbf{Ch 114 (bonds).} Across the Remembering, the Last Day and Ilmen 1 nothing crossed under the roof, out of the yard or up the clay road as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer: the five holy days ended with the Last Day and the year turned on Ilmen 1 with nothing signed, twelve arithmetics of Y.H. 813 carried unchanged behind one unsigned figure and Ilmen 10’s first reading unbrought. Each morning the surgeon took the body in its old order — one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool, the empty place beside it holding the fold put there on the fifteenth and found where put, the thread of drool frozen in the dry kiln heat and unwiped because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — knowing that a face composed by cold is not composure, that a cold patient cannot clot and must be rewarmed slowly from the outside, never hurried, never rubbed, and that pink returning is the surface still lying over a cold core. The infant wanted the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle; both true, the second louder, neither winning. With Sella the old grammar held at both ends of all three days — fire before basket, coals told the thaw, the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, dressed grain covered and unfigured, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, charcoal unread, widow’s mark untouched, the seven walked-around places once and not twice — and on the Remembering she carried him to House Silt on an errand, set the basket just inside the finger’s-width door away from every open slate and took what she came for without opening the pewter tin above the empty bed, naming the woman or speaking the number. The keeping at the fold was found where put on the mornings and goings of the light of all three days and stayed a finding, not a placing, not a habit, way, sign, gift, payment or rule. With Tarn the equality held at six counted and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged sentence, the hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, \emph{Six counted. The next I don’t count}, the term already ended and the loan uncalled; with Jorra the bent finger went into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence and came out without the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time, \emph{he’s not Vail} sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn. The boy refused to let Tarn’s stopped sentence, Jorra’s ungiven promise and the yard’s called-gone grey stand up together and call themselves a rule, for a rule is an account that has found a payer and none stood. Answers 361 through 366 were filed exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, restraints and not payments borrowing no house count and supplying no payer; the surgeon’s small satisfaction in a field taken as found and left as found cost nothing, which is how he knew it was not peace. No present-tense break and no tagged memory; the white room, the page over the speakers and the hands in the field go on gathering interest. No new scar, possession, rank or power and no change of voice.

\textbf{Ch 113 (bonds).} Through Kindling, Weighing and the Long Night nothing crossed under the roof, out of the yard or up the clay road as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer: the three holy days kept their names, had no tend-days and no market, and the year was not said to turn on any of them. Each morning the surgeon took the body in its old order — the stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool, the empty place holding the fold put there on the fifteenth and found where put, the thread of drool frozen in the dry kiln heat and unwiped because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — and knew that a basket set level out of the draught where the heat came sideways is the rewarming he would choose and cannot ask for, that a face composed by cold is not composure and that a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed slowly from outside, never hurried, never rubbed. The infant wanted the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle; both true, the second louder, neither winning. With Sella the old grammar held at both ends of all three days — fire before basket, \emph{The house will keep it}, instruction to the wool, the river wind and the fire and never to the basket, the half-pace from every open slate, the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, the dressed grain turned under wool with no figure and no handful, the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, the charcoal unread, the widow’s mark untouched, the seven walked-around places gone around once and not twice — and on the Long Night she banked the coals early, told them it was the thaw and lit no fire after dusk; at each going of the light she put the fold right at his ear and under his chin without a look at his face and added no second fold. \textbf{The chapter’s one meaningful change, advanced and NOT paid (T080/T090):} on Kindling a collector took the year’s first measure with an ordinary writing hand and no pause in it, hand to slate before eyes to bed and one flat sentence to the slate (\emph{The measure is banked. The account stands. The return is recorded.}); the boy filed that reaching on a tray of its own — not Marra, not the Court-table clerk, not the Fishstairs clerk, not the Drawing collector, not a tenth hand — and planted, unspoken, the reason that will one day be remembered against the taker, that he keeps the world alive by taking what is already going. On Weighing a clean voice announced a whole return for somebody absent, took the speaker out of his own sentences and left a name the household would not repeat; on the Long Night a neighbour’s story left a name standing empty. Both silences went on the gap tray beside the told bell’s gap with no reader, witness, payer or doctrine standing up. \textbf{The first present-tense break in eighty-eight chapters} came on the Long Night on the clean voice’s form alone — a page over the speakers, a white room that does not look up, hands staying in the field — untagged, for one or two sentences, paying nothing; the grammar fell straight back into the past and the unsent call to Nina was not paid again (T020 held). Tarn’s seventh year ended with the loan uncalled and the Seed 16 breath unspent; Jorra’s promise stayed neither given nor withdrawn; Ilva’s strip, Hessa’s unread slate and Berr’s locked box stood where last seen. The count reached 392 exact with 360 honest answers on the sixth place, each exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment; the carried fire’s fifth stayed unpaid and Garl’s name unspoken 390, 391 and 392 days.

\textbf{Ch 112 (bonds).} Through Stone 28, 29 and 30 nothing crossed under the roof, out of the yard or up the clay road as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer: the year’s last three days were lived without a boundary drawn and neither of the district’s two habits of naming its months was set right or left. Each morning the surgeon took the body in its old order — the stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool, the empty place beside it holding the fold put there on the fifteenth and found where put, the thread frozen in the dry kiln heat and unwiped because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — and knew that a basket set level out of the draught where the heat came sideways is the rewarming he would choose and cannot ask for; a face composed by cold is not composure, a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed slowly from outside, never rubbed. The infant wanted the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle; both true, the second louder, neither winning. With Sella the old grammar held at both ends of all three days — fire before basket, \emph{The house will keep it}, instruction to the wool, the river wind and the fire and never to the basket, the half-pace from every open slate, the twice-mended pot lifted thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, the dressed grain turned under wool with no figure and no handful, the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, the charcoal unread, the widow’s mark untouched, the seven walked-around places gone around once and not twice — and at each going of the light she put the fold right at his ear and under his chin without a look at his face and added no second fold. \textbf{The chapter’s one meaningful change, advanced and NOT paid (T015/T041/T047):} on Stone 30 the twelfth arithmetic went up behind one unsigned figure — the three of Frost, the first, second and third of Bone, the first, second and third of Ash, and Stone’s first, second and last — and twelve are twelve and not one account, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space and no doctrine out of twelve; twelve true subtractions ride locked in Berr’s box up the road with the key gone up in a coat pocket that never comes back down and the boy having no key. He kept the finding on a place of its own and did not lay it across the keeping at the fold, the four rooms’ gap, the four directions or any of his own gaps. With Tarn six held in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip, the hand up over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, the ear-sentence stopping at the calling word with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and the loan uncalled; with Jorra the meal-fine grey dust, the forearms parted as clot from vessel, the damper’s two bites and the promise neither given nor withdrawn; with Ilva her ninth at the well on Stone 29 with the strip unread; with Hessa the slate carried unread up the road on Stone 30; with Garl the objects and his name unspoken 387, 388 and 389 days. The hand answered six times, \textbf{349} and \textbf{350} on Stone 28, \textbf{351} and \textbf{352} on Stone 29, \textbf{353} and \textbf{354} on Stone 30, each exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer. The year went out without a boundary drawn and the Five stood beyond, unbrought; no new scar, possession, rank or power and no change of voice.

\textbf{Ch 111 (bonds).} Through Stone 25, 26 and 27 nothing crossed under the roof, out of the yard or up the clay road as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer; the eleven readings, the keeping and the fourth direction stood behind the household and bought no teaching here. Each morning the surgeon took the body in its old order — the stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool, the empty place beside it, the thread frozen in the dry heat and unwiped because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — and knew that a basket set level out of the draught is the rewarming he would choose and cannot ask for, that a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from the outside and slowly, never hurried, never rubbed; the infant wanted the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle, both true, the second louder, neither winning. With Sella the old grammar held at both ends of all three days — fire before basket, \emph{The house will keep it}, the half-pace from every open slate, the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, the dressed grain turned under wool and given no figure or handful, the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, the charcoal unread, the widow’s mark untouched, the seven walked-around places gone around once and not twice — and at each going of the light she put the fold right at his ear and under his chin without a look at his face and added no second fold. \textbf{The keeping passed from nine findings to a tenth on Stone 25, an eleventh on Stone 26 and a twelfth on Stone 27}, each found folded once in the crust’s empty place where a hand put it on the fifteenth, changed by nobody; twelve findings from a hand that only read add no twelfth placing, and a habit wants a hand that placed twice and a way a third, both wanting a payer where none stands. He filed each beside the crust’s gap, the shelf’s two gaps, the gone pan’s round ring and the field’s empty place, with a finger between every pair, and filed the small alarm at a double-digit count on a place of its own. With Tarn the six and the seventh held on all three afternoons, the hand up and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, the loan uncalled at the very end of the seventh year; with Jorra the damper’s two bites held and the promise under the wheel-shed neither given nor withdrawn; Ilva kept her ninth at the well on Stone 26 with the strip unread; Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken 384, 385 and 386 days. Twelve findings were twelve findings, eleven arithmetics eleven and four directions four and not a witness; nothing was opened, joined by a standing hand, named, called, paid or ended, no rank or power changed and no new scar or possession.

\textbf{Ch 110 (bonds).} Through Stone 22, 23 and 24 nothing crossed under the roof, out of the yard or up the clay road as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer; the eleven readings and the fourth direction stood behind the household and bought no teaching here. With Sella the old grammar held at both ends of every day — fire before basket, \emph{The house will keep it}, instruction to the wool, the river wind and the fire and never to the basket, the half-pace from every open slate, the seven walked-around places with the returning-line place widest and once and not twice, the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing, the grain covered and unfigured, the charcoal unread, the widow’s mark untouched, the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed — and at each going of the light she put the fold right at his ear and under his chin without a look at his face and \textbf{added no second fold to the empty place}. \textbf{The keeping was found a seventh, eighth and ninth time and NOT paid (T097/T060/T086):} nine findings from a hand that only read add no ninth placing; finding is not placing, a habit wants a hand that placed twice and a way wants a third, and both want a payer where none stands. With Tarn the equality held at six counted and the seventh at the lip, the hand up and away with no breath held at the top of the reach on all three afternoons, the loan uncalled at the very end of the seventh year, the fear of being entered again for vagrancy still his; with Jorra the bent finger went into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence and came out without a second holding of Ash 26, \emph{he’s not Vail} sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn. Ilva kept her ninth at the well on Stone 22 with the strip unread and no tenth; Hessa went up the clay road before noon on Stone 23 with the writing turned to her sleeve and was not made a reader; Berr’s eleven true subtractions stayed locked in his box up the road. \textbf{The chapter’s one meaningful change, advanced and NOT paid (T035/T031/T065/T095 and T101):} on Stone 23 an ownerless voice over the boards from the direction of Slate Row gave the shut room and the burned slate a fourth direction — the cold and the count going out through the same gap, with no room named, no hand at any flame, no figure, no date, no person standing — and he filed it on a place of its own beside the three older ones with a finger between every pair, not a sixth telling, not a witness, not a rule, gathering interest toward a far-off hand that is not his and has not come. No bond paid, sold, named or spoken, no new scar or possession, no change of voice.

\textbf{Ch 109 (bonds).} Through Stone 19, 20 and 21 nothing crossed under the roof, out of the yard or up the clay road as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer; the eleventh arithmetic stood behind the household and bought no teaching here, and the keeping at the fold was not joined to the reading. With Sella the old grammar held at both ends of every day — fire before basket, \emph{The house will keep it}, instruction to the wool, the river wind and the fire and never to the basket, the half-pace from every open slate, the seven walked-around places with the returning-line place widest and once and not twice, the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing, the grain covered and unfigured, the charcoal unread, the widow’s mark untouched, the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed — and at each going of the light she put the fold right at his ear and under his chin without a look toward his face and \textbf{added no second fold to the empty place}. The keeping was found where put on the mornings and at the goings of the light of all three days — a fourth, fifth and sixth finding — and six findings from a hand that only read added no seventh placing; finding is not placing, a habit wants a hand that placed twice and a way wants a third, and both want a payer where none stands. With Tarn the equality held at six counted and the seventh at the lip, the hand up and away at the top of the reach with no breath held on Stone 21, the loan uncalled at the very end of the seventh year. With Jorra the bent finger went into the damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence and came out without a second holding of Ash 26; \emph{he’s not Vail} stayed sealed and the promise to the slate-burners neither given nor withdrawn. Ilva kept her ninth at the well on Stone 19 with the strip unread; Hessa took Berr’s slate up the road unread on Stone 20 and was not made a reader by eleven arithmetics; Berr called the levy and denied it with \emph{your house}, never \emph{I}, believing he had done a kindness; the soft-cuffed clerk stayed set at the landing, the seventh green and seventh shape had no eighth, and Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken three hundred and seventy-eight, seventy-nine and eighty days. No bond paid, sold, named or spoken, no new scar or possession and no change of voice.

\textbf{Ch 108 (bonds).} Through Stone 16, 17 and 18 nothing crossed under the roof, out of the yard or up the clay road as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer: the Drawing stood behind the household with its flat knock outside the six hearings and bought no teaching, and ten arithmetics stood behind one unsigned figure with no doctrine out of ten. With Sella the old grammar held at both ends of every day — fire before basket, \emph{The house will keep it}, instruction to the wool, the river wind and the fire and never to the basket, the half-pace from every open slate, the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, the twice-mended pot lifted thumb-first with the hairline showing, the grain covered and unfigured, the charcoal unread, the widow’s mark untouched, the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed — and at each going of the light she put the fold right at his ear and under his chin without a look toward his face and \textbf{added no second fold to the empty place}. \textbf{The keeping was tested and not paid (T097/T060/T086):} found folded once in the crust’s empty place on three mornings and at three goings of the light, changed by nobody; he filed it beside the crust’s gap, the shelf’s two gaps, the gone pan’s round ring and the field’s empty place, expressly not a joining, gift, payment, payer, sixth held object, habit, way or rule, gathering interest toward the far-off finger that is not his and has not come. A hand that finds is not a hand that places, and a second placing would make a habit wanting a payer where none stands. With Tarn the equality held where it had moved to, six counted and the seventh at the lip, the ear-sentence stopped at the calling word as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled; with Jorra the bent finger went into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence and came out without a second holding of Ash 26, \emph{he’s not Vail} sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn. Ilva’s ninth at the well on the sixteenth with the strip unread and Hessa’s going \textbf{up} the road on the seventeenth with the writing to her sleeve stayed two sightings on separate places with no tenth hand, no reader and no fifth shaping; Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken 375, 376 and 377 days. No bond paid, sold, named or spoken, no new scar or possession, no change of voice.

\textbf{Ch 107 (bonds).} Through Stone 13, 14 and 15 nothing crossed under the roof, out of the yard or up the clay road as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer: the Hearth Drawing stood behind the household with its flat knock on its own place outside the six hearings and bought no teaching, the tenth arithmetic went up the clay road in Berr’s box and bought none either. With Sella the old grammar held at both ends of every day — fire before basket, \emph{The house will keep it}, instruction to the wool, the river wind and the fire and never to the basket, the half-pace from every open slate, the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, the twice-mended pot lifted thumb-first with its hairline showing, the grain covered and unfigured, the charcoal unread, the widow’s mark untouched, the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed — and the empty place beside the crust was left untouched on the mornings of the thirteenth, fourteenth and fifteenth so that what came at the going of the light on the fifteenth would be a change and not a habit. \textbf{That change was hers and was not paid (T097/T060/T086):} setting him on his bed and righting the fold without a look at his face, her hand tucked the wool into the empty place beside the crust — a small keeping, no word, no third crust, no name for the place, no instruction to the basket, the hand resting the half-beat longer than the setting needed before it went away, the thread left frozen and unwiped. He took the interval apart by what was there and by what was not and filed it on a place of its own beside the crust’s gap, the shelf’s two gaps, the gone pan’s round ring and the field’s empty place: not a joining of rooms, not a gift (a gift wants a giver and nobody gave), not a payment, no payer, not a sixth held object, not a habit or a rule, gathered once and not made again, gathering interest toward the far-off finger that is not his and has not come. With Tarn the equality held where it had moved to, six counted and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged sentence, the Ash 14 breath and Bone 26 thumb’s resting found where put and not made again, the ear-sentence stopped at the calling word as a ninth stopping with no tenth, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled; with Jorra the men unnamed went low into the back room before first grey, the wheel and a pot were spoken to before any person, the full note was withheld and the bent finger went into the cold damper with one iron’s two bites and without a second holding of Ash 26, \emph{he’s not Vail} sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn. Ilva’s ninth hand at the well on the thirteenth and Hessa’s coming down the road on the fourteenth with her writing turned to her sleeve stayed two sightings on separate places with no tenth hand and no reader, and Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken 372, 373 and 374 days. No bond paid, sold, named or spoken, no new scar or possession, no change of voice.

\textbf{Ch 106 (bonds).} Nothing crossed under the roof, out of the yard or up the clay road on Stone 10, 11 or 12 as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer: the tenth arithmetic went up the clay road in Berr Clay’s locked box behind the nine and bought no teaching under this roof; the Hearth Drawing stood behind the household with the flat knock on its own place outside the six hearings and the seventh place empty; the four rooms with the same gap stayed apart with a finger between every pair; the collector’s ordinary hand stayed on its own tray joined to none. With Sella nothing changed hands: fire before basket at both ends of every day, instruction to the wool, the river wind and the fire and never to the basket, the half-pace from every open slate, the seven walked-around places gone around with a look and no number, the bed under the roof and never the Debt Loft, the thread left frozen and unwiped; at the Drawing she set him where he could see and not join and stood half a pace off, and carried him home at the going of the light saying nothing of where they had been. With Tarn the equality held where it had moved to, six counted and the seventh at the lip, the Ash 14 breath and the Bone 26 thumb’s resting found where put and not made again, the loan uncalled; with Jorra the men unnamed went low into the back room before first grey and the bent finger went into the cold damper with one iron’s two bites, the promise neither given nor withdrawn; Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken 369, 370 and 371 days. Berr’s self-removal with \emph{your house}, Hessa’s unread slate and Ilva’s strip stayed on their own places, no tenth hand filed and no reader made of any keeping. No bond paid, sold, named or spoken, no new scar or possession, no change of voice.

\textbf{Ch 105 (bonds).} Through Stone 7, 8 and 9 nothing crossed under the roof, out of the yard or up the clay road as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, and the month came round to the day a year before without a hand under any roof naming it: Stone 7 was his first birthday in this life and was spent as an ordinary tending day — no party made, no cake baked, no figure entered, no recognition given, no threshold crossed and nobody who would know what a number counted. He kept three hundred and sixty-six, three hundred and sixty-seven and three hundred and sixty-eight exactly and did not stand the completed year up as a line; the house kept its days in loaves, in glances, in the space where a loaf had stood and in the shape a room takes when a weight is lifted out of it, and could not say a year had turned, and its not saying was neither a cruelty nor a mercy that could be entered on a slate. Each morning the surgeon’s register took the body in its old order — the leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches off with its corner a hair off the wool and its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread of drool frozen in the dry kiln heat and unwiped because nobody under any roof had ever been given an instruction about the thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here would perform — and the infant’s want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle quarrelled without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning, the argument the work. Sella came to the hearth before the basket at both ends of every day, kept the hearth grammar with the charcoal unread and the grain unfigured and the widow’s mark untouched, carried him down and up at the half-pace, went wide around the seven walked-around places and widest around the returning-line place, set him on his bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, let her hand rest the half-beat longer at the fold and left the thread frozen and unwiped, saying nothing of where they had been; with Tarn the six and the seventh, the checked breath and thumb’s resting, the ear-sentence stopped at the calling word as a ninth stopping with no tenth and the loan uncalled held at the equality’s moved place; with Jorra the dusty forearms parted as clot from vessel, the wheel and a pot spoken to before any person, the full note withheld, the damper’s two bites and the Ash 26 holding not made a second time, \emph{he’s not Vail} sealed and the promise under the wheel-shed neither given nor withdrawn; with Garl the objects and the unspoken name 366, 367 and 368 days, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid the same number. Nothing was joined, named, opened, called, paid or ended and no bond changed hands.

\textbf{Ch 104 (bonds).} Through Stone 4, 5 and 6 nothing crossed under the roof, out of the yard or up the clay road as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, and the first firing of Stone stood behind the household with no lesson anybody named. Each morning the surgeon’s register took the body in its old order — the stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool, its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread frozen in the dry kiln heat and unwiped because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread, cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — and he knew a basket set level out of the draught where the heat came sideways was the careful rewarming he would choose and could not ask for; the infant wanted the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle, and neither won, the quarrel the work. Sella carried him down and up at the half-pace, gave the instruction to the wool, the river wind and the fire she would bank against their coming back and never to the basket, went wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, widest around the returning-line place, set him on his bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft at each going of the light, righted the fold without a look at his face and left the thread frozen and unwiped. \textbf{Her one change was at the kiln on Stone 5:} before any instruction went to the basket she put her left hand to the widow’s mark, held it one breath, let go, lifted the clay lid with the back of a hand and tipped the carried coal under a broken pot; the fire took in fours with its fifth unpaid, nobody praised the opening or made a lesson of it, seven openings in seven months were seven and not a rule and no eighth was made due. With Tarn the six and the seventh held at the kindling, the checked objects found where put and not made again, the ear-sentence stopped at the calling word with no tenth and the loan uncalled; with Jorra the dusty and clean forearms parted as clot from vessel, the wheel and a pot spoken to before any person, the full note withheld, the bent finger standing a moment longer in the cold iron without leaving the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time; with Ilva the ninth hand at the well on Stone 4, strip unread and no tenth; with Garl the objects and the unspoken name three hundred and sixty-three, sixty-four and sixty-five days. No bond changed hands, no slate opened within reach of the basket, no power gained, no new scar or possession and no change of voice.

\textbf{Ch 103 (bonds).} Through Stone 1, 2 and 3 nothing crossed under the roof, out of the yard or up the clay road as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, and the river’s going under its winter skin on Stone 1 bought no lesson under any roof. Each morning the surgeon’s register took the body in its old order — the stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool and its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread frozen in the dry kiln heat and unwiped because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — and the infant’s want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle quarrelled without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning, the argument the work. Sella went to the hearth before the basket, told the coals it was the thaw, turned them with a broken pot’s back, kept the charcoal unread, the dressed grain covered and unfigured with no figure or handful and the widow’s mark untouched; she carried him down and up at the half-pace, went wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and no number, widest around the returning-line place, set him on his bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft at each going of the light, let her hand rest the half-beat longer than the setting needed and left the thread frozen and unwiped. With Tarn the six in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip held, the Ash 14 breath and the Bone 26 thumb’s resting were checked on all three days and not made again, the ear-sentence stopped at the calling word as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled; with Jorra the dusty forearms were parted from clean as clot from vessel, the wheel and a pot spoken to before any person, the full note known three turns ahead withheld, the bent finger standing in the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence and the holding of Ash 26 gathered once and not made a second time, with \emph{he’s not Vail} sealed; with Ilva the ninth record-first hand came once at the well on Stone 2 with her strip unread, no tenth made and no voice spoken; with Garl the objects and the unspoken name for 360, 361 and 362 days. No bond changed hands, no power used, no new scar or possession and no change of voice.

\textbf{Ch 102 (bonds).} Through Ash 28, 29 and 30 nothing crossed under the roof, out of the yard or up the clay road as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, and the ninth reading bought no lesson there. Sella went to the fire before the basket at both ends of every day and gave the instruction to the wool and the river wind and never to the basket; she carried him down and up at the half-pace from every open slate, went wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and no number, set him on his bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft at every going of the light, let her hand rest the half-beat longer than the setting needed and left the thread frozen and unwiped; the widow’s mark hung untouched, six openings in six months were six and not a rule and no seventh was made due. On Ash 30 she set the basket in the moot-post’s finger’s width of shade where no slate lay and stood half a pace off through Berr’s twice-read figure, carrying him home saying nothing. With Tarn the six and the seventh held and the Ash 14 breath and Bone 26 thumb’s resting were checked on all three days and not made again, the ear-sentence stopping at the calling word with no tenth stopping and the loan uncalled; with Jorra the dusty forearms, the withheld note, the damper’s two bites and the holding of Ash 26 found where put and not made a second time; with Ilva the ninth hand at the well on Ash 28 with the strip unread and no tenth; with Berr the third subtraction going up the road locked and unread with \emph{your house}, never I, and the figure read still not the figure paid; with Hessa the slate going up unread with hand before eye; with Garl the objects and the unspoken name for three hundred and fifty-seven, fifty-eight and fifty-nine days. Nothing was opened, joined by a standing hand, named, called, paid or ended, no power used, no rank changed, no new scar or possession and no change of voice.

\textbf{Ch 101 (bonds).} Through Ash 25, 26 and 27 (Days 354–356) nothing crossed under the roof, out of the yard or up the clay road as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, and nothing from Ash 22, 23 or 24 crossed over either. Each morning the surgeon’s register took the body in its old order — the stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches off with its corner a hair off the wool, its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread frozen in the dry kiln heat and unwiped because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — and the infant’s want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle quarrelled without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning, the argument the work (T060/T086). Sella went to the fire before the basket at both ends of every day, told the coals it was the thaw and \emph{The house will keep it} where another woman would say I, turned them with a broken pot’s back, kept the charcoal unread and the dressed grain turned under wool with a touch lighter than a woman would use on a sleeping child and no figure or handful, lifted the twice-mended pot thumb-first where the wire crossed the crack with the hairline showing between old-brass staple and tighter wire, and set the rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed; she carried him down and up at the half-pace, went wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and no number, set him on the bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft at each going of the light, righted the fold without a look at his face and left the thread; the widow’s mark hung untouched and no seventh opening was made due (T058/T079/T100, T077). Tarn kept six in the worn thumb-mark where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, knife at the edge of its sill, said \emph{Six counted. The next I don’t count}, checked the Bone 26 thumb’s resting and the Ash 14 held breath on all three days and found each where put and not made again, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled (T036/T076/T006). Jorra parted dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel and a pot before any person, withheld the note known three turns ahead and put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence. \textbf{The one meaningful change, advanced and NOT paid (T062/T035/T031 and T061/T082):} on Ash 26, after the tongue had been moved, the sentence finished and the household straightened around the waiting — after the work was done, not before — his bent finger stayed in the cold iron a breath longer than the work required. He filed the extra interval on a place of its own with a finger between it and the five held objects, the pot-crack resting, the hand-at-the-sill breath and his own gaps: a private keeping gathered once and not spent, expressly not a sixth held object, not a seventh, not an eighth of anything, not a habit, a way, a hearing, a near-full answer, a mending, a cause, a payment or a rule, with no payer standing under it, gathering toward the far-off hand that will lay the district’s private keepings together, and that hand not his. On Ash 27 the finger came out and the interval was found where it had been put and not made again, for a second would be a habit and a third a way and both want a payer. \emph{He’s not Vail} stayed sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn. Ilva came once to the well on Ash 26 with her hand to sleeve before her eyes to the asker and her mouth after both, answered \emph{Ask the pot what it cost.
